evidence.excerpt:
Older AI chips are still selling in a tight market.

Prices for Nvidia’s H100 remain high because chip shortages are still limiting supply.

The demand shows that AI companies are still willing to buy proven hardware when newer accelerators are difficult to secure. As long as shortages persist, older chips can remain commercially valuable and raise the cost of expanding AI computing capacity.
